# Recreation Prompt

Create a self-contained browser-native portrait space shooter titled **Bat Signal: Space Shooter Arcade**. Preserve the source mechanics: the player ship smoothly follows one-thumb pointer drag, fires automatically only while input is active, destroys falling rocks, splits larger rocks into smaller rocks, earns score by rock tier, and loses immediately on player-rock contact. Reinterpret the presentation as a satirical neon-noir bat-inspired future arcade session with a prism batwing focal actor, orbital city bat-signal backdrop, meme meteors, rizz score HUD, and fast mobile start/restart overlays. Use Canvas and vanilla JavaScript with inline CSS/JS; do not add new mechanics or multiplayer networking.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: Mobile-first canvas space shooter / asteroid-defense arcade game.
- objective: Keep the player ship alive while destroying falling rocks for score.
- input model: Pointer/touch drag on the playfield; the ship smoothly follows the finger with a small vertical offset and auto-fires only while input is active.
- core loop: Spawn large falling rocks, fire upward projectiles, split hit rocks into smaller rocks, award tier-based score, increase spawn pressure as score rises, render particles/shake feedback.
- fail/friction state: Circular rock/player collision immediately ends the run and shows a restart overlay with final score.

## Protected mechanics
- One-thumb drag/follow movement using the existing smoothing value, screen clamps, and finger offset.
- Auto-fire cadence while input is active; no new manual fire button.
- Falling rock spawn model, descending velocity, horizontal drift, and score-based spawn-rate pressure.
- Bullet-vs-rock circle collision, rock splitting from tier 3 to 2 to 1, tier-based score values of 100/200/300 via `(4-tier)*100`.
- Player-vs-rock collision fail state, final score display, and restart behavior.
- Canvas requestAnimationFrame loop, particle/shake feedback, and mobile portrait playfield.

## Remixed target
Bat Signal: Space Shooter Arcade reframes the same mechanic truth as a satirical neon-noir bat-inspired space shooter session. The player pilots a prism batwing drone through a futuristic orbital city signal, shooting meme meteors for rizz score while friends-session copy and arcade HUD language keep onboarding fast and mobile-readable.
